name: donat
description: Game top-up storefront with mock payments and mock fulfillment (real integrations disabled by default).

scripts.postinstall: npm run build -w @donat/shared && npm run prisma:generate -w @donat/api
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @donat/api" "npm run dev -w @donat/web"
scripts.dev:all: concurrently -k -n db,api,web -c gray,blue,magenta "npm run db:start" "wait-on tcp:127.0.0.1:5433 && npm run dev -w @donat/api" "npm run dev -w @donat/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @donat/shared && npm run build -w @donat/api && npm run build -w @donat/web
